<!-- Follow CONTRIBUTING.md. Leave ABI allocations, kernel pins and release notes to
maintainers during release preparation. Do not announce approvals or test conclusions
on anyone else's behalf; report only the evidence below. -->

## Problem and change

Why is this needed? Link the issue and describe the resulting behavior.

## Sources and licensing

Upstream links/commits, original authors and licenses, local modifications, and NOTICE/SPDX updates
(or “no imported content”).

## Validation

Commands/checks and results. For hardware: model/panel, stock build, kernel release/commit,
integration commit or image identity, reproduction steps and sanitized logs.

## Untested or limited

What remains untested? Include absent/failed optional-hardware behavior if affected.

## Documentation

English/Chinese files updated together, or why no documentation change is needed.
